description_en: Queries whether you can submit a free one-click check. The check scope includes free vulnerability check categories and free Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) check items
description_zh: 获取能否提交免费一键检测，检测范围包含免费漏洞检测类别和CSPM免费检查项
name: GetTenantCheckAvailable

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The ID is an Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

NextScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the next time when a one-click check can be submitted
NextScanTime.description_zh: 下一次可以提交一键检测时间的时间戳

Status.description_en:
The current status of the one-click check. Valid values:

0: The one-click check can be submitted.

1: The current task is not completed and the check cannot be submitted.

2: The free check quota for this week has been used. Wait for the next free check time
Status.description_zh:
当前一键检测状态，枚举值：

0：可以提交一键检测。

1：当前任务尚未完成，无法提交检测。

2：本周检测免费检测额度已使用，需等待下次免费检测时间

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
